meta.name: llamaindex
meta.description: Data framework for building LLM applications with RAG. Specializes in document ingestion (300+ connectors), indexing, and querying. Features vector indices, query engines, agents, and multi-modal support. Use for document Q&A, chatbots, knowledge retrieval, or building RAG pipelines. Best for data-centric LLM applications.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 构建带知识库的问答和检索应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果要用文档数据构建LLM问答或检索系统
copy.tagline_en: Build Q&A and retrieval apps with your documents
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to build LLM-powered Q&A or retrieval from your documents

howto.what: Claude 能使用 LlamaIndex 框架连接 300 多种数据源（文档、网页、数据库等），构建向量索引并执行检索增强生成（RAG），从而实现基于私有数据的文档问答、知识库检索和多轮对话。
howto.when: 当你要求进行文档问答、知识检索或构建 RAG 管道等涉及私有数据的 LLM 应用时触发。

say.text: 用 LlamaIndex 对我的研究报告做问答
say.note: Claude 会加载文档、构建索引并回答问题。

say.text: 帮我用 LlamaIndex 创建一个维基百科页面的知识库
say.note: Claude 会抓取网页内容并建立向量索引。

say.text: 用 LlamaIndex 从 PDF 文件夹中检索机器学习相关段落
say.note: Claude 会进行语义检索，返回最相关的文本片段。

howto.what_en: Claude uses LlamaIndex to connect 300+ data sources, build vector indices, and perform RAG for document Q&A, knowledge retrieval, and multi-turn chats on private data.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to do document Q&A, knowledge retrieval, or build a RAG pipeline with private data. Also when ingesting data from multiple sources.

say_en.text: Use LlamaIndex to do Q&A on my research report.
say_en.note: Claude loads docs, builds index, and answers.

say_en.text: Create a knowledge base from Wikipedia pages using LlamaIndex.
say_en.note: Claude scrapes pages and builds a vector index.

say_en.text: Retrieve paragraphs about machine learning from my PDF folder using LlamaIndex.
say_en.note: Claude performs semantic retrieval for the best matches.
